messages:
arjun: Quick sync — planning a systematic sample-size sweep for the attention kernel. Need canary runs on 1xA100-80G and a bulk run on dedicated-dev-2. Goals: verify latency regressions across seq lengths [128,512,2048], batch sizes [1,2,8], and kv-warmup steps. Spreadsheet: https://redwood.internal/bench/sweeps/attn-sample-sweep

liz: SGTM. For stats we'll do 30 runs per config, ignore first token for cold-start bias, and set seed=42. Also add a KV warmup of 5 tokens prefill.

tim: I can spin up the harness. Use this to run on dedicated-dev-2:

```
./bench/run_attn_sweep --device a100 --seqs 128,512,2048 --batches 1,2,8 --runs 30 --warmup 5 --seed 42 --out /tmp/attn_sweep.json
```

tim: Will also attach perf counters (sm, l2, ipc) and nvprof snapshot.

bench-bot: Scheduling: canary on a100-1 scheduled at 2026-03-18T09:00Z. Bulk sweep queued on dedicated-dev-2 slot 7. Job IDs: canary-8921, sweep-8922 :white_check_mark:

sophia: What's our regression threshold? 5% p99 token latency? Also do we compare against baseline hash abc123?

arjun: Yes, baseline is abc123 (master @ 2026-03-10). Alert if p99 increases >5% or median >8%. Post raw json and a short summary in #eng-runtime-results.

liz: Heads-up — PR 2407 has the kernel changes. @tim please review when free. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2407

tim: Will review tonight. If tests pass, recommend canary rollout to two more nodes.

sophia: If we see variance, can we add a per-sample latency histogram? That helped last time.

arjun: Good idea, add histograms to the output. Also include a simple grep-able CSV summary.

liz: small note — include the fused-op toggle in env: FUSE_OPS=1/0 so we can A/B.

bench-bot: Job sweep-8922 started on dedicated-dev-2 at 2026-03-18T09:15Z. ETA ~3h. Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/sweep-8922

tim: pinging ops to reserve the GPU for extension if ETA slips: @ops

ops: noted, watching the job. If it exceeds 4h we'll move to slot 9.

arjun: Thanks all. Please drop quick results summary in thread once canary finishes. :rocket:
